_comment: Letters and literacy. `items` are one variant each; `sweeps` expand their axes into every combination and `cap` takes an even spread when that would be more than anyone wants. Validated against each generator's own options, so a typo here fails in seconds rather than in a hundred build jobs.

release.name: teacher-aids-alphabet
release.title: Teacher Aids: Letters and Literacy
release.summary: Printable alphabet sets in six themes -- chunky blocks, textured faces, animal tiles, hollow outlines, finger-tracing cards and cut-through windows -- plus letter stencils with the bridges built in. Every set shares one font at one baseline, so tiles from different themes still line up when a child spells with them.

items.name: letter-tile_a-z_blocky_40mm_with-bar
items._comment: the orientation bar is what stops b, d, p and q being picked up as each other, which is the single most common confusion at this age

items.name: letter-tile_A-Z_tracing_60mm
items._comment: a tracing groove has to take a five-year-old's fingertip: 2.6 mm deep and a 14 mm stroke at this size

items.name: letter-tile_vowels_patterned_45mm
items._comment: vowels in their own texture, so a set sorts by feel as well as by sight

sweeps.name: letter-tile_A-F_{theme}_{tile_size}mm
sweeps._comment: a sampler: six tiles per theme so a school can print one of each and decide before committing to twenty-six
